workingTreeNote: Evidence was produced with checkpoint changes in the working tree; unrelated pre-existing changes were preserved.
classification: PENDING + CANCEL UX ACCEPTED FOR PRODUCTION POLICY / DEFAULT SWITCH DEFERRED

decision.pendingStatus: Show while a current Frontier operation is active.
decision.cancel: Show while pending; cancellation means keep the already usable current Product layout.
decision.veryFastCompletion: No debounce or fixed display delay is adopted. The status is lifecycle-driven and only exists while the operation is active.
decision.provisionalStyling: Adopt graph-only opacity/saturation treatment while pending; do not style application chrome or introduce partial geometry.
decision.terminalStatus: Keep cancelled/fallback explanation until the next operation or Dataset acceptance; clear stale state during invalidation/replacement.
decision.successStatus: No extra success banner; remove pending treatment and return to the ordinary graph presentation after render-only adoption.

browserMatrix.observed: Pending was visible at initial, 120ms, and 620ms observations; later state was completed with no status and graph opacity 1.
Pending status and Cancel were visually understandable; graph-only provisional treatment was visible; status and toolbar had no overlap after the bounded layout fix; console errors 0.
Fallback graph and application chrome remained usable while pending; visual review caught and then verified removal of the status/viewport-toolbar overlap; console errors 0.
Pending lifecycle completed with Japanese status strings available and console errors 0.

timingObservation.interpretation: These browser measurements include fixture navigation/open overhead, so they are not solver runtime. All four controls exposed a visible pending state long enough to inspect; no evidence required a debounce.

accessibilityAndViewport.cancel: native enabled button, keyboard reachable, focus-visible rules remain global and unchanged
accessibilityAndViewport.chrome: Add Entity and other application controls remained enabled where normally enabled; no global disabled state
accessibilityAndViewport.narrowViewport: Status is responsive and wraps below 720px; existing mobile viewport controls remain the Product path. A browser viewport override was not available in this connected browser, so this point is source-backed responsive evidence rather than a narrow screenshot.
accessibilityAndViewport.toolbarSeparation: Status is outside graph-section flow; pending screenshot and DOM rectangles show status bottom before viewport toolbar top.

coverage: complete finite success and render-only adoption
DEV-only seam, status/cancel/provisional styling, status/toolbar separation, and idle cleanup

adoptionBoundary: The pending + Cancel UX policy is accepted as the natural production policy, but wiring Frontier into the normal coordinate-less provider and changing production default remain a separate checkpoint. Human Review and provider selection are not reopened.
